record.edic_text:
2947 kulioo {koo-lee-o'-o}

from base of 2949 (through the idea of circularity, cf 2945, 1507);; v

AV - wallow 1; 1

1) a rolling, wallowing
2) to roll itself in mud
3) to wallowing in the mire
